title: Canonical delta-functor structure on topological abelian sheaf cohomology
statement: For a topological space $X$, let $H^p(X,F)$ be the cohomology of an abelian sheaf $F$ defined in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], for $p\geq 0$. For every short exact sequence $0\to A\to B\to C\to 0$ of abelian sheaves on $X$, take the connecting map $H^p(X,C)\to H^{p+1}(X,A)$ to be Yoneda composition with the extension class of the sequence. These functors and connecting maps form a cohomological $\delta$-functor [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor], together with the canonical identification $H^0(X,F)\to\Gamma(X,F)$ given by evaluation on the generator of the free abelian sheaf on the whole space.
